scan.one_line: Wipro reported flat sequential constant currency revenue growth and an operating margin of 16.5% for Q2 FY27.
not_said: No net profit or PAT growth guidance percentage

items.quote: Our operating margin for the quarter was 16.5%, an improvement of 0.5% compared to last quarter.

items.statement: Working towards improving margins while creating headspace for growth through operational improvements.
items.quote: We will work towards improving the margins even as we create headspace for growth.
Our IT services revenue stood at $2.61 billion, flat sequentially and up 0.6% year-on-year in constant currency.

items.statement: Total contract value of $2.6 billion with nine large deals signed in the quarter.
items.quote: This quarter, we closed $2.6 billion in total contract value and signed nine large deals.

items.statement: Minus 1.5% to plus 0.5% in constant currency for Q3
items.quote: We are guiding for a sequential IT services revenue growth of minus 1.5% to plus 0.5% in constant currency.

items.statement: Launched AI native unit with over 2,000 engineers to drive outcome-based deals.
items.quote: In April, if you recollect, we launched our AI native unit to help clients transition from traditional delivery models to AI native enterprises.

items.statement: Healthcare sector in the US continues to be affected by policy changes.
items.quote: However, healthcare in US continues to be affected by policy changes.

scan.one_line: Heritage Foods delivered 19% YoY revenue growth in Q2 FY27 despite elevated milk procurement inflation.

items.quote: Consolidated revenue grew 19% year -on-year to INR13,196 million in quarter 2

items.statement: Launch of Nourish+ High Protein Curd and Greek Yogurt
items.quote: During the quarter, we strengthened our high protein portfolio with the launch of Nourish+ High Protein Curd containing 25 grams of protein and Greek Yogurt available in single-serve packs containing 8 grams of protein and midsized packs containing 40 grams of protein.

items.statement: Elevated milk procurement costs and supply side constraints
items.quote: While elevated procurement costs continue to weigh on profitability, EBITDA stood at INR740 million with a margin of 5.6%

not_said: No precise breakdown of exact unit-wise capacity utilization.
No specific long-term revenue guidance beyond FY27.

items.statement: EBITDA per kilo will more or less remain intact in the range of INR135 to INR140.
items.quote: I think INR135 to INR140 we had said last time. That is where it stays.
achieving a value growth of 7.8% on the back of a double-digit volume growth.
and the net profit stands at INR130 crores with a growth of almost 29%.

items.statement: Robust order position for Q3 and Q4.
items.quote: The order position for Q3 and Q4 looks robust

items.statement: 15% volume growth for the full year.
items.quote: we expect to end the year exactly as per the guidance that we had given at the start of the year, which was around 15% volume growth

items.statement: Similar EBITDA growth of around 15% for the year.
